candidates.instruction: In the editable `counter` module, replace the `count == {WIDTH{1'b0}}` test used for `at_zero` with `~(|count)`, and replace the all-ones wrap test `count == {WIDTH{1'b1}}` with `&count`. Preserve the existing registered outputs, synchronous reset, reset > load > enable priority, overflow hold behavior, threshold comparisons, and pre-update flag semantics; do not add or remove pipeline stages or add a numeric latency annotation. Validate high-bit values, wraparound, disabled/load cycles, reset behavior, and all supported `WIDTH` and threshold parameter values.
